Portrait of a Samburu woman breasfteeding an infant from Kisima, Kenya. The woman is wearing a large number of colourful beaded necklaces and a bead cowl around her neck and shoulders, a beaded headband, and gold metal pendant earrings hung over her ears with hide thongs.

View of a Samburu village in Archers Post, Kenya. More traditional buildings are clustered in front, with more modern buildings at the rear. Herds of animals are grazing around he village and a camel is sat resting in the foreground.

A Samburu family from Kisima, Kenya. The family includes a breast feeding woman with an infant, a young man carrying a spear, a girl carrying bottles in her cloak and wearing an elaborate beaded head dress, and two young boys. The woman, girl and two young boys are wearing a large number of colourful beads and cowls around their necks and shoulders, have coiled metal armlets and a variety of ear piercings, decorated with bead loops or wooden plugs in stretched ear lobes.
